reference_tolerance_discussion.basis: Explicit exploratory working choices exceeding seen ML whole-window trend/CV while preserving adequate observed counts; not confidence limits, power, free-flow certification or universal thresholds.
reference_tolerance_discussion.do_not_use: No hard adjacent-bin5% rule, and no claim that mean stability proves stationary traffic.
reference_tolerance_discussion.decide_before_B_complete: Reviewer must accept exact estimand and tolerances or retain unknown. Fixed primary denominator and no post-result reference reselection.

entry_qualification.scope: Network insertion only. Never impose equality of requested, entered, merge passage, detector contrib, detector entered, or common-domain crossing counts in the same calendar window.
entry_qualification.failure_meaning: Complete observations showing sustained insertion delay are observed input-supply mismatch and not_resolved for intended comparison, not evidence corruption. Missing/invalid delay or identity is an evidence error.

TT_boundary_algorithm.crossing: Each observed crossing is an interval [last_below_time, first_at_or_above_time]. For half-open bin[a,b), certain cohort requires lower>=a and upper<b; possible cohort has upper>=a and lower<b. Conservative endpoint treatment is intentional.
TT_boundary_algorithm.optional_membership: Keep definite cohortD and ambiguous cohortA separately. Compute minimum average over k=0..|A| of (sum lower_D + sum k smallest lower_A)/(nD+k). Compute maximum average using upper_D and k largest upper_A. Record exact denominator attaining each extremum; never replace ambiguous by zero.
TT_boundary_algorithm.zero_denominator: Exclude empty-set means from arithmetic and return no_contributors if no nonempty eligible set. Required minimum sample uses definite count, not favorable optional additions.
TT_boundary_algorithm.right_censor: For entered cohort with no exit by valid observation end, lower=max(0,end_of_observation-start_upper), upper=unbounded. Retain it. Any mandatory or possible censored reference member gives conservative reference upper unbounded. No finite censor value is invented.
TT_boundary_algorithm.robust_support: challenge mean lower > (1+registered_delta)*reference mean upper, with all required entry/reference/sample rules. If reference upper unbounded, support is not identified.
TT_boundary_algorithm.classification: Valid but ambiguous/censored bounds that do not prove support =>not_resolved. Corrupted/missing required source data or independently inconsistent computation =>blocked_by_evidence_error.
TT_boundary_algorithm.bin_membership_coherence: Independent worst-case bounds per bin are conservative. Do not choose mutually incompatible favorable memberships across bins to fabricate a support block.

sensitivity_algorithm.register_before_outcomes: List exact parameter combinations and applicability in a separate sensitivity key table; rules, cohort and all seeds stay fixed.
sensitivity_algorithm.primary_and_sensitivity: Evaluate primary first, then all required sensitivity combinations. Report per-seed pass/fail/indeterminate with numeric bounds; no choice of favorable bins or thresholds after results.
sensitivity_algorithm.flip: Any registered required sensitivity classification differing from primary, or any required seed disagreement, yields not_resolved for robust suitability; retain primary result descriptively.
sensitivity_algorithm.insufficient_bin_samples: Do not relax sample count or bridge missing bins to preserve persistence. A stricter registered sensitivity with insufficient valid support is indeterminate/not_resolved, not an automatic PASS.
sensitivity_algorithm.no_automatic_threshold_grid: Candidate values listed earlier are discussion options until reviewer registers the actual sensitivity set; do not silently create a full combinatorial gate or shrink its denominator.
